topic: Adding a news section to the corporate site
summary_markdown: A request was made to implement a NEWS section on the corporate website, requiring a list of headlines and dates, dedicated news pages with images, and an administrative backend. Since no suitable Angular component was found internally, it was suggested that someone assign this task to Dima. The optimal approach proposed is connecting the site to a WordPress REST API, as someone (Kristina) is proficient with WordPress, allowing for the admin panel on WordPress while having two dedicated pages built on the main site.
decisions: The news section will be implemented using a WordPress backend and its REST API.
action_items: Someone should assign the task of investigating market components for the news section to Dima.
